Adrian Ibrahim
adrian.ibrahim342@example.com | Boise, ID
Adrian Ibrahim has 9 years of experience in sales. Most recently, Enterprise
Account Executive at Thistledown Consumer Goods (2022-2026), where they built
and ran a cold-outreach pipeline generating 158 qualified leads per month.
Before that, Senior Account Executive at Riverside Retail (2018-2022). Before
that, Account Executive at Ferro Consulting (2017-2018). Education: B.A.
Communications, University of Maryland, 2016. Core skills: Quota attainment,
Salesforce, CRM tools, Cold outreach, Negotiation, Pipeline forecasting.
